title: Learning Quest: Bahasa Malaysia
subtitle: Practical Malaysian Malay for daily life, work, and integration in Malaysia
targetCertFullName: Sijil Kecekapan Bahasa Melayu bagi Warganegara Asing (Malaysian Examinations Council / MPM)
secondaryVariant: Standard Bahasa Malaysia (bahasa baku) for forms and official settings
notes: This file is the top-level manifest. Each unit lives in units/<unit-id>.json with the shape documented in schema/language-quest-schema.md.
Register tags on every vocab item: 'colloquial' (bahasa pasar, everyday KL speech), 'standard' (bahasa baku, forms/official), or 'rojak' (Manglish code-switch, introduced from B1).
All Malay content in this batch should be reviewed by a Malaysian native speaker (ideally KL-based) before publishing, per the caveats in the research report.
Mon glosses ('mon' field) are left as null placeholders for MRLC's Mon-speaking staff to fill in using the existing MonDictDB dataset.
